sources.title: BBMP Citizen Services — Trade License
sources.notes: The public Trade License section exposes separate links for how to get a new or renewal licence, public new registration, public renewal, MOH contact/address details, and the FAQ. The page is a directory; it does not establish a current case result or current GBA target.

sources.title: Online New Trade License Registration — public payment guide
sources.notes: Direct public PDF. It describes mandatory fields, Next, owner-consent/lease and electricity-bill uploads, Send OTP/enter OTP, years selection and payment. No field, OTP, upload or payment was used.

sources.title: FAQ — Trade License
sources.notes: Direct public FAQ, with legacy/date caveat. It states 1–5-year selection, owner-consent/lease and electricity bill, optional OC, JPG/PDF and maximum 1 MB, no part-payment, and receipt/status/download features. Treat current implementation as unverified.

sources.title: Annexure G — Procedure for Applying for New Trade Licence
sources.notes: Direct official procedure PDF. It lists owner consent and latest property-tax receipt, Zone A neighbour consent, layout plan, licence/power demand drafts, rejection with endorsement when requirements are missing, and inspection scheduling within a maximum of 3 working days. The document is dated/legacy and is not proof of the current GBA implementation.

sources.title: Annexure F — Application for Trade New Licence
sources.notes: Direct official application form. It exposes Schedule X classification, health-officer jurisdiction, zonal classification, document checks, separate licence/power drafts, refusal-refund wording, and suspension/cancellation caveats. It is dated/legacy. No form was completed.

sources.title: Form B — Format of Owner’s Consent
sources.notes: Direct official owner-consent form. It requests the property number/address, latest property-tax receipt or other title document, proposed trade and zone, and records that the Corporation may issue, suspend, withdraw or cancel a licence. No personal data was entered.

sources.title: Online Trade License System (OTLS) — workflow description
sources.publisher: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike IT Department
sources.notes: Direct official IT description, published 2019 and therefore dated. It describes temporary application/payment challan, online/offline payment, inspection/document verification, staged MoH/DHO/HO review, final approval and status/license output.

sources.title: Trade License Contact — zonal Health Officer and technical contacts
sources.notes: Direct public contact page. It gives zone-wise Health Officer contacts, hours, Sahaaya 2.0 and a BBMP IT technical contact. The page is legacy/dated; use as a recovery lead, not as proof that every listed contact remains current.

claims.text: Section 353 of the Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act provides that a place within city limits may not be used for purposes listed in Schedule X without a licence from the Commissioner, subject to statutory provisos including an MSME/large-industry exemption inserted by amendment.
claims.notes: Category and exemption applicability require case-specific legal/current municipal review.
